title: Chocolate Tofu Pudding
summary: This Chocolate Tofu Pudding is proof that dessert can be both decadent and nourishing. It's naturally dairy-free, rich in nutrients, and comes together in just minutes—no fancy equipment or long prep …
ingredients: 2-3 tablespoons milk (optional for a looser texture if desired)
steps: Melt the chocolate:Microwave method: Place chocolate chips in a microwave-safe bowl. Heat in 20-second bursts, stirring between each, until fully melted and smooth.Stovetop method: Place chocolate chips in a heatproof bowl over a small pot of gently simmering water (make sure the bottom of the bowl doesn't touch the water). Stir until melted and smooth.Set the melted chocolate aside to cool slightly.
Blend Until Smooth: In a blender or food processor, combine silken tofu, cocoa powder, melted chocolate, dates, and vanilla. Blend until completely smooth.
Adjust Consistency: If too thick, add 1 tablespoon of milk at a time and blend until creamy.
Chill and serve: Scoop the pudding into bowls or jars. Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to help it firm up a little.
Optional toppings: Top with fresh berries, a sprinkle of cocoa powder, mini chocolate chips, or a dollop of whipped cream for extra fun.
